trip.name: Trip.com
trip.note: Most codes are tied to a payment card or region and are first come, first served. Hong Kong amounts are in HK$. Paste the code on the payment page.
trip.note_zh: 大部分優惠碼與付款卡或地區掛鈎，先到先得。香港金額以港幣計。在付款頁貼上優惠碼。

sbc.name: Sicily by Car
sbc.note: No open public promo right now. Every valid code is for a group, and the counter asks for proof at pickup. Without it they charge full price or can refuse the car. You need a credit card in the driver's name. A Black Friday code usually appears in late November.
sbc.note_zh: 現時沒有公開優惠。所有有效優惠碼都屬特定團體，取車時櫃枱會要求證明，否則會收原價或拒絕租車。須有主司機名下的信用卡。黑色星期五優惠碼通常在 11 月下旬推出。

europcar.name: Europcar
europcar.note: Current discounts are built-in offers: book through the offer page, no code to type. The two Italy offers can't be stacked, so compare both for your dates. You need a credit card in the main driver's name.
europcar.note_zh: 現時的折扣都是內置優惠：經優惠頁預訂，不用輸入優惠碼。兩個意大利優惠不能疊加，按你的日期比較兩者。須有主司機名下的信用卡。

klook.name: Klook
klook.note: Hong Kong codes are listed in HK$ and most have a minimum spend and a quota, so popular ones run out early. Many need a specific card or wallet (Mastercard, UnionPay, PayMe, AlipayHK, Octopus). Enter the code on the payment page; one code per order.
klook.note_zh: 香港優惠碼以港幣列出，大多有最低消費及名額，熱門的很快用完。很多須用指定信用卡或電子錢包（Mastercard、銀聯、PayMe、AlipayHK、八達通）。在付款頁輸入優惠碼，每張訂單限用一個。

hotelscom.name: Hotels.com
hotelscom.note: The 8% codes work on the Hong Kong site with a card issued in Hong Kong. One room per booking, and not with "Pay at hotel". Some codes only work through the bank's own Hotels.com link.
hotelscom.note_zh: 92 折優惠碼適用於香港網站及香港發出的信用卡。每次預訂一間房，不適用於「到店付款」。部分優惠碼只能經銀行專屬的 Hotels.com 連結使用。

expedia.name: Expedia
expedia.note: Bank codes work only on the bank's own Expedia Hong Kong page (for example expedia.com.hk/amex), for prepaid hotel-only bookings. Packages and pay-at-hotel rates don't qualify. Type the code in "Enter voucher code" at payment.
expedia.note_zh: 銀行優惠碼只適用於銀行專屬的 Expedia 香港頁面（例如 expedia.com.hk/amex），只限預付純酒店預訂。套票及到店付款不適用。在付款時「輸入優惠碼」一欄輸入。

agoda.name: Agoda
agoda.note: Most Agoda savings are claim-link deals and card pages, not codes. Codes take a percentage off the room rate only (not taxes), and the real saving is often smaller than the headline.
agoda.note_zh: Agoda 的優惠大多是領取連結及信用卡專頁，而非優惠碼。優惠碼只減房價百分比（不包稅項），實際省下的通常比標題少。

booking.name: Booking.com
booking.note: Booking.com almost never uses public promo codes. Sign in to get Genius prices (10–20% off at properties with the blue Genius label) and look for Getaway or Late Escape deals. Codes on coupon sites are usually fake or partner-only.
booking.note_zh: Booking.com 幾乎從不使用公開優惠碼。登入後可享 Genius 價（有藍色 Genius 標籤的住宿 8 至 9 折），並留意 Getaway 或 Late Escape 優惠。優惠網站上的優惠碼通常是假的或只限合作夥伴。

skyscanner.name: Skyscanner
skyscanner.note: Skyscanner is a price comparison site, not a seller, so it has no promo codes. You book on the airline or agent site it sends you to (Trip.com, Opodo, Kiwi.com, the airline). Apply codes for that site instead. The same goes for Kayak and Google Flights.
skyscanner.note_zh: Skyscanner 是比價網站，不是賣家，所以沒有優惠碼。你會在它轉介的航空公司或代理網站預訂（Trip.com、Opodo、Kiwi.com、航空公司），改用該網站的優惠碼。Kayak 及 Google Flights 亦一樣。

kiwi.name: Kiwi.com
kiwi.note: Kiwi.com codes on coupon sites are mostly old. One code per booking. Check the price drops before you pay.
kiwi.note_zh: 優惠網站上的 Kiwi.com 優惠碼大多已舊。每次預訂限用一個。付款前檢查價格有否下降。

opodo.name: Opodo / eDreams
opodo.note: Opodo and eDreams push their paid Prime membership for discounts. Coupon-site codes hide the code text and many are old Black Friday codes. App-only offers come and go.
opodo.note_zh: Opodo 及 eDreams 主力推銷付費 Prime 會員折扣。優惠網站隱藏優惠碼文字，很多是舊的黑色星期五優惠碼。App 專屬優惠時有時無。

avis.name: Avis
avis.note: Avis uses AWD numbers (company or club rates) and coupon codes. Public savings come from the free Avis Preferred programme and offers on the Avis deals page. Only use an AWD number you're entitled to; the counter can check.
avis.note_zh: Avis 使用 AWD 編號（公司或會所價）及優惠券碼。公開優惠來自免費的 Avis Preferred 計劃及 Avis 優惠頁。只使用你有資格的 AWD 編號，櫃枱可以查核。

hertz.name: Hertz
hertz.note: Hertz discounts use a CDP code (from an employer, club or card) plus an optional PC promotional code. Using a CDP you're not entitled to can get the rental repriced at the counter.
hertz.note_zh: Hertz 折扣使用 CDP 碼（來自僱主、會所或信用卡）加可選的 PC 推廣碼。使用不合資格的 CDP，櫃枱可能重新計價。

sixt.name: Sixt
sixt.note: Sixt has few public rental codes. Most shared codes are for its chauffeur and ride service. Check the Sixt offers page for your country.
sixt.note_zh: Sixt 公開租車優惠碼很少。大部分流傳的優惠碼是專車服務用的。查看你所在國家的 Sixt 優惠頁。

rentalcars.name: Rentalcars.com
rentalcars.note: Rentalcars.com rarely accepts codes. Coupon-site codes were last seen working in 2022. Card and airline partner links are the reliable way to get a discount.
rentalcars.note_zh: Rentalcars.com 很少接受優惠碼。優惠網站的優惠碼最後一次有效是 2022 年。信用卡及航空公司合作連結才是可靠的折扣途徑。

discovercars.name: Discover Cars
discovercars.note: One code per booking, not combined with other promotions, and usually not on prepaid partner packages from Hertz or Europcar.
discovercars.note_zh: 每次預訂限用一個優惠碼，不可與其他推廣同用，通常不適用於 Hertz 或 Europcar 的預付套票。

iherb.name: iHerb
iherb.note: One code per order. HK codes need a Hong Kong delivery address and often an account limit. Codes take money off the product total, not shipping.
iherb.note_zh: 每張訂單限用一個優惠碼。香港優惠碼須用香港送貨地址，通常有帳戶限制。優惠碼只減貨品總額，不減運費。

hktvmall.name: HKTVmall
hktvmall.note: Most codes are for specific categories (beauty, baby, appliances) and only count spend on those items. VIP members get 5% on Wednesdays and Citi HKTVmall cardholders 5% on Thursdays, with codes shown in the app.
hktvmall.note_zh: 大部分優惠碼只適用於指定類別（美容、嬰兒、電器），只計算該類貨品的消費。VIP 會員逢星期三 95 折，Citi HKTVmall 信用卡逢星期四 95 折，優惠碼在 App 內顯示。

taobao.name: Taobao
taobao.note: Codes are in RMB (¥) and first come, first served, especially during Double 11 (20 Oct to 13 Nov 2026). Payment method matters: AlipayHK and PayMe have their own codes, and a normal HK credit card adds about 5% in fees.
taobao.note_zh: 優惠碼以人民幣（¥）計，先到先得，雙 11 期間（2026 年 10 月 20 日至 11 月 13 日）尤其如此。付款方式有影響：AlipayHK 及 PayMe 有各自的優惠碼，一般香港信用卡會多收約 5% 手續費。

zalora.name: Zalora
zalora.note: One code per order. Free delivery from HK$299. New members get a first-order discount after signing up to the newsletter.
zalora.note_zh: 每張訂單限用一個優惠碼。滿 HK$299 免運費。新會員訂閱電子報後可享首單折扣。

dyson.name: Dyson
dyson.note: Codes work on selected products only on the Dyson Hong Kong online store.
dyson.note_zh: 優惠碼只適用於 Dyson 香港網店的指定產品。

watsons.name: Watsons
watsons.note: Watsons online codes are often free gifts with a minimum spend, not money off.
watsons.note_zh: 屈臣氏網店優惠碼通常是滿額送禮品，不是減價。

pns.name: PARKnSHOP
pns.note: Online store codes. Some only work with click & collect.
pns.note_zh: 網店優惠碼。部分只適用於店舖自取。

charleskeith.name: Charles & Keith
charleskeith.note: First-purchase code on the Hong Kong online store.
charleskeith.note_zh: 香港網店首次購物優惠碼。

crocs.name: Crocs
crocs.note: New member code on the Hong Kong online store.
crocs.note_zh: 香港網店新會員優惠碼。

foodpanda.name: foodpanda
foodpanda.note: Enter the code at checkout in the app. New-user codes work on your first order only. Card and wallet codes have a limited quota each month. pandapro members get free delivery from HK$120 at many restaurants.
foodpanda.note_zh: 在 App 結帳時輸入優惠碼。新用戶優惠碼只適用於首單。信用卡及電子錢包優惠碼每月限量。pandapro 會員在很多餐廳滿 HK$120 免運費。

keeta.name: Keeta
keeta.note: Codes are tied to the payment method (AlipayHK, PayMe) and run until the quota runs out. New users get bigger first-order discounts automatically in the app.
keeta.note_zh: 優惠碼與付款方式掛鈎（AlipayHK、PayMe），額滿即止。新用戶在 App 內自動獲得更大的首單折扣。

airalo.name: Airalo
airalo.note: Travel eSIM. One code per purchase; new-account codes only work on a fresh account.
airalo.note_zh: 旅遊 eSIM。每次購買限用一個優惠碼；新帳戶優惠碼只適用於全新帳戶。

trainline.name: Trainline
trainline.note: Trainline rarely has public codes. The referral discount attaches to your email, so there is no code to type.
trainline.note_zh: Trainline 很少有公開優惠碼。推薦折扣綁定你的電郵，不用輸入優惠碼。

moretickets.name: MoreTickets
moretickets.note: Concert and show tickets for Hong Kong and Macau.
moretickets.note_zh: 香港及澳門演唱會及表演門票。

airbnb.name: Airbnb
airbnb.note: Airbnb rarely has public promo codes. Savings come from weekly and monthly stay discounts set by hosts, and Airbnb gift cards sometimes sold below face value. Coupon-site codes are often referral credits for new accounts.
airbnb.note_zh: Airbnb 很少有公開優惠碼。省錢方法主要是房東設定的每週及每月長住折扣，以及偶爾低於面值出售的 Airbnb 禮品卡。優惠網站上的優惠碼多是新帳戶的推薦獎賞。

marriott.name: Marriott Bonvoy
marriott.note: Book on marriott.com while signed in to the free Marriott Bonvoy programme to get member rates, usually a few percent below the public rate. Promo and corporate codes go in the "Special rates" box; only use a corporate code you're entitled to.
marriott.note_zh: 登入免費的 Marriott Bonvoy 會員後在 marriott.com 預訂，可享會員價，通常比公開價低幾個百分點。推廣碼及公司碼在「特別房價」一欄輸入；只使用你有資格的公司碼。

hilton.name: Hilton
hilton.note: Hilton Honors is free to join and members get a discounted member rate when booking direct on hilton.com or the app. Promotion codes go in "Special rates" at search.
hilton.note_zh: Hilton Honors 免費加入，會員在 hilton.com 或 App 直接預訂可享會員折扣價。推廣碼在搜尋時的「特別房價」輸入。

ihg.name: IHG Hotels
ihg.note: IHG One Rewards members get a member rate at Holiday Inn, InterContinental, Crowne Plaza and other IHG hotels. Sign in before searching to see it.
ihg.note_zh: IHG One Rewards 會員在 Holiday Inn、InterContinental、Crowne Plaza 等 IHG 酒店可享會員價。搜尋前先登入即可看到。

cathay.name: Cathay Pacific
cathay.note: Cathay promo codes are usually tied to a card (HSBC, Mastercard, PayPal) or a region's website, and go in the promo code box on the booking page. Check the Offers page for your country; Asia Miles members also get member-only fares.
cathay.note_zh: 國泰優惠碼通常與信用卡（滙豐、Mastercard、PayPal）或某地區網站掛鈎，在預訂頁的優惠碼欄輸入。查看你所在地區的優惠頁；亞洲萬里通會員亦有會員專享票價。

hkexpress.name: HK Express
hkexpress.note: HK Express runs flash fare sales and payment partner offers (AlipayHK, bank cards) more often than public codes. Promo codes go in the box on the first booking step. Bags and seats cost extra, so compare the total.
hkexpress.note_zh: HK Express 較常推出閃購機票及付款夥伴優惠（AlipayHK、銀行卡），公開優惠碼較少。優惠碼在預訂第一步輸入。行李及選位另外收費，比較總價。

googleflights.name: Google Flights
googleflights.note: Google Flights compares fares and sends you to the airline or agent to pay, so it has no promo codes. Turn on price tracking for your route and use the seller's codes when you book.
googleflights.note_zh: Google Flights 只比較票價，再轉你到航空公司或代理付款，所以沒有優惠碼。為你的航線開啟價格追蹤，預訂時改用賣家的優惠碼。

kayak.name: Kayak
kayak.note: Kayak is a price comparison site, so its codes are rare. Use its price alerts and then apply the seller's codes when you book.
kayak.note_zh: Kayak 是比價網站，優惠碼很少。使用價格提示，預訂時改用賣家的優惠碼。

singapore.name: Singapore Airlines
singapore.note: Singapore Airlines promo codes are mostly bank or card offers tied to one country's website. KrisFlyer members get occasional member fares.
singapore.note_zh: 新加坡航空的優惠碼多是綁定某國網站的銀行或信用卡優惠。KrisFlyer 會員不時有會員票價。

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.note: Enterprise discounts come from corporate accounts and Enterprise Plus membership. Use a corporate code only if you're entitled to it.
enterprise.note_zh: Enterprise 折扣來自公司帳戶及 Enterprise Plus 會員。只使用你有資格的公司碼。

budget.name: Budget
budget.note: Budget is part of the Avis group and uses BCD numbers (company rates) and coupon codes. Pay Now rates are usually cheaper than Pay Later.
budget.note_zh: Budget 屬 Avis 集團，使用 BCD 編號（公司價）及優惠券碼。即付價通常比後付價便宜。

alamo.name: Alamo
alamo.note: Alamo shows its discounts as built-in deals by country; coupon codes are uncommon. Alamo Insiders (free) gives a small discount in many countries.
alamo.note_zh: Alamo 的折扣多以各國內置優惠顯示，優惠券碼不常見。免費的 Alamo Insiders 在多國可享少量折扣。

holafly.name: Holafly
holafly.note: Travel eSIM with unlimited data plans. One code per purchase, applied at checkout.
holafly.note_zh: 無限數據旅遊 eSIM。每次購買限用一個優惠碼，結帳時輸入。

omio.name: Omio
omio.note: Omio sells trains, buses and flights in Europe. Codes are mostly for new users in the app.
omio.note_zh: Omio 售賣歐洲火車、巴士及機票。優惠碼多是 App 新用戶專用。

raileurope.name: Rail Europe
raileurope.note: European train tickets and rail passes in one place. Sales are seasonal; codes go in the basket.
raileurope.note_zh: 一站式購買歐洲火車票及鐵路通行證。折扣按季推出，優惠碼在購物車輸入。

twelvego.name: 12Go
twelvego.note: Trains, buses and ferries across Southeast Asia. Codes are uncommon; prices are already close to the operators'.
twelvego.note_zh: 東南亞火車、巴士及渡輪票。優惠碼不常見，價格本身已接近營運商價。

prioritypass.name: Priority Pass
prioritypass.note: Airport lounge membership. Many HK credit cards include free Priority Pass visits, which usually beats any code.
prioritypass.note_zh: 機場貴賓室會籍。很多香港信用卡已包免費 Priority Pass 使用次數，通常比任何優惠碼更划算。

welcomepickups.name: Welcome Pickups
welcomepickups.note: Pre-booked airport transfers with an English-speaking driver. First-ride codes are common for new accounts.
welcomepickups.note_zh: 預約機場接送，司機會說英語。新帳戶常有首程優惠碼。

safetywing.name: SafetyWing
safetywing.note: Travel and nomad insurance billed every 4 weeks. Discounts are usually referral links rather than codes. Check what it covers before you buy.
safetywing.note_zh: 按每 4 星期收費的旅遊及遊牧保險。折扣多是推薦連結而非優惠碼。購買前先看清保障範圍。

amazon.name: Amazon
amazon.note: Amazon.com and Amazon.co.uk ship many items to Hong Kong. Codes are product-specific (clip the coupon on the product page). Prime free shipping to HK depends on the store and order size.
amazon.note_zh: Amazon.com 及 Amazon.co.uk 很多貨品可寄香港。優惠碼多是個別產品專用（在產品頁點選優惠券）。Prime 免運費到香港視乎網站及訂單金額。

aliexpress.name: AliExpress
aliexpress.note: Codes are store coupons or platform codes with a minimum spend, and they peak during 11.11 and other big sales. One platform code per order.
aliexpress.note_zh: 優惠碼分店舖優惠券及平台碼，都有最低消費，在 11.11 等大型購物節最多。每張訂單限用一個平台碼。

temu.name: Temu
temu.note: New-user bundles and percentage codes are common. Check the final price after shipping and the return conditions.
temu.note_zh: 常有新用戶優惠包及百分比折扣碼。留意運費後的最終價格及退貨條件。

shein.name: Shein
shein.note: Codes are tiered by spend (e.g. a bigger discount over a higher total). One code per order.
shein.note_zh: 優惠碼按消費金額分級（消費越多折扣越大）。每張訂單限用一個。

farfetch.name: Farfetch
farfetch.note: Luxury fashion from boutiques worldwide, ships to HK. App first-order codes are the most common; sale items are often excluded.
farfetch.note_zh: 來自全球精品店的奢侈時裝，可寄香港。最常見的是 App 首單優惠碼；減價貨品通常不適用。

asos.name: ASOS
asos.note: ASOS ships to Hong Kong. Codes appear around sales and student discounts (via UNiDAYS). One code per order.
asos.note_zh: ASOS 可寄香港。優惠碼多在減價期出現，學生可經 UNiDAYS 享折扣。每張訂單限用一個。

selfridges.name: Selfridges
selfridges.note: London department store with international delivery to Hong Kong. Public codes are rare; savings come from seasonal sales and Selfridges Plus delivery.
selfridges.note_zh: 倫敦百貨公司，提供寄往香港的國際送貨。公開優惠碼很少，省錢主要靠季節性減價及 Selfridges Plus 送貨服務。

harrods.name: Harrods
harrods.note: London department store that ships to Hong Kong. Harrods almost never issues public codes; Harrods Rewards members earn points and get sale previews.
harrods.note_zh: 寄往香港的倫敦百貨公司。Harrods 幾乎從不發出公開優惠碼；Harrods Rewards 會員可賺積分及搶先參與減價。

uber.name: Uber
uber.note: Uber works in Hong Kong and most countries. Promo codes go in Wallet → Promotions in the app before you ride. New-rider codes only work on a new account.
uber.note_zh: Uber 在香港及大部分國家都可使用。乘車前在 App「錢包 → 優惠」輸入優惠碼。新乘客優惠碼只適用於新帳戶。

ubereats.name: Uber Eats
ubereats.note: Food delivery in many countries (not Hong Kong). Codes go in the checkout screen; first-order codes need a new account.
ubereats.note_zh: 多國可用的外賣平台（香港沒有）。在結帳頁輸入優惠碼；首單優惠碼需新帳戶。

grab.name: Grab
grab.note: Rides and food in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and other Southeast Asian countries. Codes are per country; add them under Offers in the app.
grab.note_zh: 在新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國等東南亞國家提供乘車及外賣。優惠碼按國家分，在 App「優惠」加入。

didi.name: DiDi
didi.note: Ride hailing in Mainland China (DiDi also runs in Hong Kong). New-user coupons appear in the app; HK visitors can link AlipayHK or a card.
didi.note_zh: 中國內地叫車平台（香港亦有 DiDi）。新用戶優惠券在 App 內顯示；香港旅客可綁定 AlipayHK 或信用卡。

hktaxi.name: HKTaxi
hktaxi.note: Hong Kong's taxi-hailing app. Discounts come from payment partners and app promotions rather than public codes.
hktaxi.note_zh: 香港召的士 App。折扣多來自付款夥伴及 App 推廣，而非公開優惠碼。

deliveroo.name: Deliveroo
deliveroo.note: Food delivery in the UK and Europe (it left Hong Kong in 2025). First-order codes need a new account; Deliveroo Plus gives free delivery.
deliveroo.note_zh: 英國及歐洲的外賣平台（2025 年已退出香港）。首單優惠碼需新帳戶；Deliveroo Plus 可享免運費。

doordash.name: DoorDash
doordash.note: Food delivery in the US, Canada and Australia. First-order codes and DashPass trials are common.
doordash.note_zh: 美國、加拿大及澳洲的外賣平台。常有首單優惠碼及 DashPass 試用。

bolt.name: Bolt
bolt.note: Rides across Europe and Africa, often cheaper than Uber. First-ride codes need a new account.
bolt.note_zh: 歐洲及非洲的叫車平台，通常比 Uber 便宜。首程優惠碼需新帳戶。

kkday.name: KKday
kkday.note: Tours, tickets and transport across Asia. Codes are often tied to a card (HSBC, Citi) or a region's site and go in the payment step.
kkday.note_zh: 亞洲的旅遊團、門票及交通。優惠碼通常與信用卡（滙豐、Citi）或地區網站掛鈎，在付款步驟輸入。

getyourguide.name: GetYourGuide
getyourguide.note: Tours and attractions worldwide. App first-booking codes are the most common; free cancellation on most activities.
getyourguide.note_zh: 全球旅遊團及景點。最常見的是 App 首次預訂優惠碼；大部分活動可免費取消。

viator.name: Viator
viator.note: Tripadvisor's tours and activities site. Codes are occasional and mostly for app bookings.
viator.note_zh: Tripadvisor 旗下的旅遊團及活動網站。優惠碼不常有，多是 App 預訂專用。

cityline.name: Cityline
cityline.note: Hong Kong's main concert and show ticketing site. There are no discount codes; bank cards get priority booking periods instead.
cityline.note_zh: 香港主要的演唱會及表演門票網站。沒有折扣碼，但銀行卡持有人可享優先訂票。

ticketmaster.name: Ticketmaster
ticketmaster.note: Concert and event tickets worldwide. Presale codes come from artist sign-ups and card issuers, not public coupon sites.
ticketmaster.note_zh: 全球演唱會及活動門票。預售碼來自歌手登記及信用卡發卡機構，而非優惠網站。

tiqets.name: Tiqets
tiqets.note: Museum and attraction tickets with instant mobile entry. App and newsletter codes are the usual source.
tiqets.note_zh: 博物館及景點門票，手機即時入場。優惠碼多來自 App 及電子報。

headout.name: Headout
headout.note: Shows, attractions and tours in major cities. First-booking codes are common in the app.
headout.note_zh: 大城市的表演、景點及旅遊團。App 常有首次預訂優惠碼。

accor.name: Accor (ALL)
accor.note: Accor runs Novotel, Ibis, Sofitel, Pullman and more. ALL Accor members (free) get member rates, and flash sales run a few times a year.
accor.note_zh: Accor 旗下有 Novotel、Ibis、Sofitel、Pullman 等酒店。免費加入 ALL Accor 會員可享會員價，每年亦有數次閃購。

premierinn.name: Premier Inn
premierinn.note: The UK's biggest budget hotel chain. Book early for Saver rates (non-refundable); public promo codes are rare.
premierinn.note_zh: 英國最大的經濟型連鎖酒店。提早預訂可享 Saver 價（不可退款）；公開優惠碼很少。

travelodge.name: Travelodge
travelodge.note: UK budget hotels with SuperSaver rates when you book ahead. Codes appear mostly in newsletter sales.
travelodge.note_zh: 英國經濟型酒店，提早預訂有 SuperSaver 價。優惠碼多在電子報減價時出現。

priceline.name: Priceline
priceline.note: US booking site for hotels, flights and cars. Express Deals hide the hotel name until you book for a lower price; codes are occasional.
priceline.note_zh: 美國的酒店、機票及租車預訂網站。Express Deals 預訂前不顯示酒店名稱但價格較低；優惠碼不常有。

hyatt.name: Hyatt
hyatt.note: World of Hyatt members (free) get member rates when booking direct. Promo and corporate codes go in the Special Rates box.
hyatt.note_zh: 免費加入 World of Hyatt 會員，直接預訂可享會員價。推廣碼及公司碼在「特別房價」欄輸入。

vrbo.name: Vrbo
vrbo.note: Holiday homes, mostly in the US and Europe (part of Expedia). Discounts are set by owners for longer stays; codes are rare.
vrbo.note_zh: 度假屋，主要在美國及歐洲（屬 Expedia 集團）。長住折扣由屋主設定；優惠碼很少。

emirates.name: Emirates
emirates.note: Emirates promo codes are mostly bank and card offers on one country's website. Skywards members get occasional member fares.
emirates.note_zh: 阿聯酋航空的優惠碼多是某國網站的銀行或信用卡優惠。Skywards 會員不時有會員票價。

qatar.name: Qatar Airways
qatar.note: Qatar Airways runs regular fare sales and student discounts (Student Club). Promo codes go in the booking box on the first page.
qatar.note_zh: 卡塔爾航空定期有機票優惠及學生折扣（Student Club）。優惠碼在首頁預訂欄輸入。

ba.name: British Airways
ba.note: BA codes are usually for holidays (flight + hotel) rather than flights alone. Executive Club members get occasional sale access.
ba.note_zh: 英航優惠碼多用於套票（機票加酒店），單買機票較少。Executive Club 會員可搶先參與部分減價。

easyjet.name: easyJet
easyjet.note: Budget airline across Europe. Flight codes are rare; easyJet holidays has codes more often. Bags and seats cost extra.
easyjet.note_zh: 歐洲廉航。機票優惠碼很少，easyJet holidays 套票較常有。行李及選位另外收費。

ryanair.name: Ryanair
ryanair.note: Europe's biggest budget airline. No promo codes: it runs seat sales instead. Check-in online to avoid airport fees.
ryanair.note_zh: 歐洲最大廉航。沒有優惠碼，改以機位減價取代。記得網上登機，避免機場收費。

jet2.name: Jet2
jet2.note: UK leisure airline and holiday company. Jet2holidays has occasional codes; flight prices include 22kg bags on holidays.
jet2.note_zh: 英國度假航空及旅行社。Jet2holidays 不時有優惠碼；套票已包 22 公斤行李。

delta.name: Delta
delta.note: US airline. Codes (eCertificates) are personal, sent to SkyMiles members; public codes are rare.
delta.note_zh: 美國航空公司。優惠碼（eCertificate）是個人專用，只寄給 SkyMiles 會員；公開碼很少。

united.name: United Airlines
united.note: US airline. Promo codes are mostly personal MileagePlus offers or card perks. Enter them under Promotion code at search.
united.note_zh: 美國航空公司。優惠碼多是個人的 MileagePlus 優惠或信用卡福利，搜尋時在 Promotion code 輸入。

american.name: American Airlines
american.note: US airline. Public codes are rare; AAdvantage members and cardholders get targeted offers.
american.note_zh: 美國航空公司。公開優惠碼很少；AAdvantage 會員及信用卡持有人會收到專屬優惠。

southwest.name: Southwest
southwest.note: US airline with two free checked bags. Promo codes come by email to Rapid Rewards members during fare sales.
southwest.note_zh: 免費兩件寄艙行李的美國航空公司。減價期間會電郵優惠碼給 Rapid Rewards 會員。

scoot.name: Scoot
scoot.note: Singapore Airlines' budget airline. Sales and promo codes come often, through its newsletter and app. Bags cost extra.
scoot.note_zh: 新加坡航空旗下廉航。經常透過電子報及 App 推出減價及優惠碼。行李另外收費。

jetstar.name: Jetstar
jetstar.note: Budget airline in Asia and Australia. Friday Fare Frenzy sales beat most codes. Bags cost extra.
jetstar.note_zh: 亞洲及澳洲廉航。Friday Fare Frenzy 減價通常比優惠碼更划算。行李另外收費。

national.name: National
national.note: US car rental (Enterprise group). Emerald Club members (free) pick any car in the aisle. Discounts come from corporate codes.
national.note_zh: 美國租車公司（Enterprise 集團）。免費 Emerald Club 會員可在停車場自選車輛。折扣多來自公司碼。

turo.name: Turo
turo.note: Rent cars from private owners in the US, UK and other countries. First-trip credits are referral-based; check the insurance level.
turo.note_zh: 在美國、英國等地向私人車主租車。首程優惠多是推薦獎賞；留意保險級別。

nationalexpress.name: National Express
nationalexpress.note: UK coaches between cities and airports. Fun Fares from £5 and coachcards (young person, senior) save more than codes.
nationalexpress.note_zh: 英國城市及機場之間的長途巴士。£5 起的 Fun Fares 及優惠卡（青年、長者）比優惠碼更省。

amtrak.name: Amtrak
amtrak.note: US trains. Saver fares, Share Fares for groups and the USA Rail Pass are the main ways to save; codes appear in seasonal sales.
amtrak.note_zh: 美國火車。Saver 票價、團體 Share Fares 及 USA Rail Pass 是主要省錢方法；季節性減價時會有優惠碼。

ebay.name: eBay
ebay.note: eBay runs sitewide codes a few times a month (often with a cap and minimum spend). Many sellers ship to HK; check import charges.
ebay.note_zh: eBay 每月有數次全站優惠碼（通常有上限及最低消費）。很多賣家寄香港；留意進口費用。

argos.name: Argos
argos.note: UK catalogue store. Codes are uncommon; deals come from price drops and multi-buy offers. Delivers in the UK only.
argos.note_zh: 英國目錄店。優惠碼不常見，折扣多是減價及多買優惠。只送英國。

johnlewis.name: John Lewis
johnlewis.note: UK department store with a price-match promise. Public codes are rare; My John Lewis members get member offers.
johnlewis.note_zh: 英國百貨公司，承諾價格匹配。公開優惠碼很少；My John Lewis 會員可享會員優惠。

next.name: Next
next.note: UK fashion and homeware that ships to Hong Kong. Codes are rare outside the big seasonal sales.
next.note_zh: 可寄香港的英國時裝及家品店。除大型季節性減價外，很少有優惠碼。

boots.name: Boots
boots.note: UK pharmacy and beauty. Advantage Card points and 3-for-2 offers beat most codes. Some items ship internationally.
boots.note_zh: 英國藥房及美容店。Advantage Card 積分及「買三付二」通常比優惠碼更划算。部分貨品可寄海外。

walmart.name: Walmart
walmart.note: US retailer. Codes are rare; Walmart+ gives free delivery, and Rollbacks are its built-in price cuts. Ships within the US.
walmart.note_zh: 美國零售商。優惠碼很少；Walmart+ 可免運費，Rollback 是內置減價。只送美國。

target.name: Target
target.note: US retailer. Target Circle (free) gives app coupons and a birthday reward. Ships within the US.
target.note_zh: 美國零售商。免費 Target Circle 有 App 優惠券及生日獎賞。只送美國。

bestbuy.name: Best Buy
bestbuy.note: US electronics store. Codes are rare; open-box items and member deals (My Best Buy) save more.
bestbuy.note_zh: 美國電器店。優惠碼很少；開箱貨品及會員優惠（My Best Buy）更省。

macys.name: Macy's
macys.note: US department store with frequent sitewide codes during sales. Check the exclusions list; some brands never take codes.
macys.note_zh: 經常在減價期推出全站優惠碼的美國百貨公司。留意不適用清單，部分品牌從不接受優惠碼。

shopee.name: Shopee
shopee.note: Singapore's biggest marketplace. Vouchers are claimed in the app, and the biggest drops are on double-date sales (9.9, 11.11, 12.12).
shopee.note_zh: 新加坡最大的網購平台。優惠券在 App 內領取，雙數日子大減價（9.9、11.11、12.12）最多。

lazada.name: Lazada
lazada.note: Southeast Asian marketplace (Alibaba group). Collect vouchers in the app before checkout; stack store and platform vouchers.
lazada.note_zh: 東南亞網購平台（阿里巴巴集團）。結帳前在 App 領取優惠券，可疊加店舖及平台優惠券。

qoo10.name: Qoo10
qoo10.note: Marketplace popular in Singapore for Korean and Japanese goods. Daily cart coupons are claimed in the app.
qoo10.note_zh: 在新加坡流行的網購平台，主打韓日貨品。每日購物車優惠券在 App 內領取。

lyft.name: Lyft
lyft.note: Rides in the US and Canada. New-rider codes go under Promos in the app; they only work on a new account.
lyft.note_zh: 美國及加拿大的叫車平台。新乘客優惠碼在 App「Promos」輸入，只限新帳戶。

justeat.name: Just Eat
justeat.note: Food delivery in the UK and Europe. Codes go in the basket; many are restaurant-specific.
justeat.note_zh: 英國及歐洲的外賣平台。在購物車輸入優惠碼，很多只限指定餐廳。

openrice.name: OpenRice
openrice.note: Hong Kong restaurant guide with table booking. Deals are booking offers and vouchers shown on each restaurant page, not codes.
openrice.note_zh: 香港餐廳指南，可訂枱。優惠是各餐廳頁面上的訂座優惠及現金券，不是優惠碼。

chope.name: Chope
chope.note: Restaurant booking in Hong Kong and Singapore. ChopeDeals sells discounted dining vouchers in the app.
chope.note_zh: 香港及新加坡的餐廳訂座平台。ChopeDeals 在 App 內出售折扣餐飲券。

lalamove.name: Lalamove
lalamove.note: Same-day van and courier delivery in Hong Kong and Asia. First-order codes go in the app before you place the order.
lalamove.note_zh: 香港及亞洲的即日貨車及速遞服務。首單優惠碼在落單前於 App 輸入。

freenow.name: FREENOW
freenow.note: Taxi and ride app in London and other European cities. First-ride codes need a new account.
freenow.note_zh: 倫敦及歐洲多個城市的的士及叫車 App。首程優惠碼需新帳戶。

grubhub.name: Grubhub
grubhub.note: US food delivery. Codes go in checkout; Grubhub+ gives free delivery and is free for Amazon Prime members in the US.
grubhub.note_zh: 美國外賣平台。在結帳時輸入優惠碼；Grubhub+ 可免運費，美國 Amazon Prime 會員免費使用。

instacart.name: Instacart
instacart.note: US and Canada grocery delivery. First-order codes and Instacart+ trials are common.
instacart.note_zh: 美國及加拿大的雜貨送遞平台。常有首單優惠碼及 Instacart+ 試用。

gojek.name: Gojek
gojek.note: Rides in Singapore and Indonesia. Promos are added under Vouchers in the app.
gojek.note_zh: 新加坡及印尼的叫車平台。優惠在 App「Vouchers」加入。

tada.name: TADA
tada.note: Singapore ride app with no commission on drivers, often cheaper at peak times. Promo codes go in the app.
tada.note_zh: 新加坡叫車 App，不向司機抽佣，繁忙時間通常較便宜。在 App 內輸入優惠碼。

stubhub.name: StubHub
stubhub.note: Resale marketplace for concert, sports and theatre tickets. Codes are rare; compare the total price with fees.
stubhub.note_zh: 演唱會、體育及劇場門票轉售平台。優惠碼很少；比較連手續費的總價。

urbtix.name: URBTIX
urbtix.note: Hong Kong's government ticketing for shows and events at public venues. Concessions (students, seniors) are the main discounts.
urbtix.note_zh: 香港政府的公營場地表演及活動票務系統。主要折扣是優惠票（學生、長者）。

hkticketing.name: HK Ticketing
hkticketing.note: Hong Kong ticketing for concerts, theatre and exhibitions. Bank cards get priority booking and occasional discounts.
hkticketing.note_zh: 香港演唱會、劇場及展覽票務網站。銀行卡持有人可優先訂票，不時有折扣。

seetickets.name: See Tickets
seetickets.note: UK ticketing for gigs, festivals and theatre. No public codes; sign up for presale alerts.
seetickets.note_zh: 英國音樂會、音樂節及劇場票務網站。沒有公開優惠碼；可登記預售通知。

seatgeek.name: SeatGeek
seatgeek.note: US ticket marketplace. First-purchase codes appear for new accounts; Deal Score shows good-value seats.
seatgeek.note_zh: 美國門票平台。新帳戶有首次購買優惠碼；Deal Score 顯示性價比高的座位。

sistic.name: SISTIC
sistic.note: Singapore's main ticketing site for concerts and shows. Bank card presales and discounts are the usual deals.
sistic.note_zh: 新加坡主要的演唱會及表演票務網站。常見優惠是銀行卡預售及折扣。

pelago.name: Pelago
pelago.note: Singapore Airlines' tours and activities app. Codes are frequent for KrisFlyer members and new users.
pelago.note_zh: 新加坡航空旗下的旅遊活動 App。KrisFlyer 會員及新用戶經常有優惠碼。

lufthansa.name: Lufthansa
lufthansa.note: Germany's flag carrier, part of Star Alliance. Codes are rare; Miles & More members and student fares get the best prices. Light fares have no checked bag.
lufthansa.note_zh: 德國漢莎航空，星空聯盟成員。優惠碼很少；Miles & More 會員及學生票價最划算。Light 票價不包寄艙行李。

airfrance.name: Air France
airfrance.note: Air France runs regular fare sales and Flying Blue member Promo Rewards. Promo codes go in the booking box on the home page.
airfrance.note_zh: 法國航空定期有機票優惠，Flying Blue 會員另有 Promo Rewards。優惠碼在首頁預訂欄輸入。

klm.name: KLM
klm.note: Dutch airline (Air France–KLM group). Sales and Flying Blue offers are the usual savings; codes come with partner and card offers.
klm.note_zh: 荷蘭皇家航空（法航荷航集團）。主要省錢方法是減價及 Flying Blue 優惠；優惠碼多來自合作夥伴及信用卡優惠。

wizzair.name: Wizz Air
wizzair.note: Budget airline across Central and Eastern Europe. Wizz Discount Club (paid) lowers fares; bags and seats cost extra.
wizzair.note_zh: 中東歐廉航。付費 Wizz Discount Club 可減機票價；行李及選位另外收費。

eurail.name: Eurail
eurail.note: Rail passes for non-European residents, covering trains in 33 countries. Seasonal sales take 10–25% off; youth and senior passes are cheaper.
eurail.note_zh: 供非歐洲居民使用的鐵路通行證，覆蓋 33 國火車。季節性減價可享 10–25% 折扣；青年及長者通行證較便宜。

flixbus.name: FlixBus
flixbus.note: Low-cost coaches across Europe and the US. Vouchers come from newsletters and refunds; book early for the lowest fares.
flixbus.note_zh: 歐洲及美國的低價長途巴士。優惠券多來自電子報及退款；提早預訂最便宜。

zalando.name: Zalando
zalando.note: Europe's biggest online fashion store, with free returns in most countries. Newsletter sign-up usually gives a first-order code; ships within Europe only.
zalando.note_zh: 歐洲最大的網上時裝店，大部分國家免費退貨。登記電子報通常有首單優惠碼；只送歐洲。

glovo.name: Glovo
glovo.note: Food and grocery delivery in Spain, Italy, Portugal and Eastern Europe. First-order codes go in the app's Promo section.
glovo.note_zh: 在西班牙、意大利、葡萄牙及東歐提供外賣及雜貨送遞。首單優惠碼在 App 的 Promo 一欄輸入。

wolt.name: Wolt
wolt.note: Food delivery in Northern and Eastern Europe, Germany and Japan (DoorDash group). Referral codes give credit on the first orders.
wolt.note_zh: 在北歐、東歐、德國及日本提供外賣（DoorDash 集團）。推薦碼可在首幾單獲贈額度。

civitatis.name: Civitatis
civitatis.note: Tours and free walking tours in Europe and Latin America, often cheaper than the big sites. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
civitatis.note_zh: 歐洲及拉丁美洲的旅遊團及免費步行團，價格通常比大型網站便宜。出發前 24 小時可免費取消。

rakutentravel.name: Rakuten Travel
rakutentravel.note: Japan's biggest hotel booking site, with ryokan and business hotels the global sites miss. Coupons are claimed on the coupon page before you book; the English site has fewer of them.
rakutentravel.note_zh: 日本最大的酒店預訂網站，有很多國際網站沒有的旅館及商務酒店。預訂前在優惠券頁面領取優惠券；英文版的優惠券較少。

jalan.name: Jalan
jalan.note: Recruit's Japanese hotel and ryokan site. Coupons are claimed in advance and often stack with points; mostly in Japanese.
jalan.note_zh: Recruit 旗下的日本酒店及旅館網站。優惠券需預先領取，常可與積分同用；以日文為主。

jal.name: Japan Airlines
jal.note: JAL runs regional fare sales on each country's site, plus the free Japan Explorer Pass for domestic flights when you fly in from abroad.
jal.note_zh: 日本航空在各地網站推出機票優惠；海外旅客另可購買 Japan Explorer Pass 搭乘國內航班。

ana.name: ANA
ana.note: All Nippon Airways. Look for sales on your country's ANA site; foreign visitors can buy cheap domestic fares with the Experience Japan Fare.
ana.note_zh: 全日空。留意你所在地區 ANA 網站的減價；外國旅客可用 Experience Japan Fare 以低價搭乘國內航班。

peach.name: Peach
peach.note: Japanese budget airline flying to Hong Kong, Taiwan and Korea. Flash sales beat codes; bags and seats cost extra.
peach.note_zh: 日本廉航，航線包括香港、台灣及韓國。閃購通常比優惠碼更划算；行李及選位另外收費。

timescar.name: Times Car Rental
timescar.note: Japan's large car rental chain with English booking. Web discounts apply automatically; bring an International Driving Permit.
timescar.note_zh: 日本大型租車公司，可用英文預訂。網上折扣自動套用；記得攜帶國際駕駛執照。

toyotarent.name: Toyota Rent a Car
toyotarent.note: Toyota's rental network covers almost every station and airport in Japan. Early-booking rates are cheapest; ETC cards for tolls cost extra.
toyotarent.note_zh: Toyota 租車網絡幾乎覆蓋日本所有車站及機場。提早預訂價最便宜；收費道路用的 ETC 卡另外收費。

jrpass.name: Japan Rail Pass
jrpass.note: Unlimited JR trains for 7, 14 or 21 days. Since the 2023 price rise it only pays off for long trips; regional passes are often better value.
jrpass.note_zh: 7、14 或 21 日任搭 JR 火車。2023 年加價後只適合長途行程；地區通行證通常更划算。

rakuten.name: Rakuten
rakuten.note: Japan's biggest online mall. Coupons are per shop and platform; points campaigns (Super Sale, 5 and 0 days) give the most back. Some shops ship abroad.
rakuten.note_zh: 日本最大的網上商場。優惠券分店舖及平台；積分活動（Super Sale、逢 5 及 0 日）回贈最多。部分店舖可寄海外。

zozotown.name: ZOZOTOWN
zozotown.note: Japan's biggest fashion site. Coupons appear in the app; ships within Japan, so use a forwarding service from abroad.
zozotown.note_zh: 日本最大的時裝網站。優惠券在 App 內出現；只送日本，海外需用轉運服務。

gotaxi.name: GO Taxi
gotaxi.note: Japan's main taxi app, works in Tokyo, Osaka and most cities with foreign cards. First-ride coupons are entered in the app.
gotaxi.note_zh: 日本主要的召的士 App，東京、大阪等多個城市可用外國信用卡。首程優惠券在 App 內輸入。

tabelog.name: Tabelog
tabelog.note: Japan's top restaurant guide, with online booking for many places. No codes; some restaurants offer booking-only course deals.
tabelog.note_zh: 日本最權威的餐廳指南，很多餐廳可網上訂座。沒有優惠碼；部分餐廳有網上訂座專享套餐。

yanolja.name: Yanolja
yanolja.note: Korea's big hotel and motel booking app. Coupons are claimed in the app before booking; the global site has fewer of them.
yanolja.note_zh: 韓國大型酒店及汽車旅館預訂 App。預訂前在 App 內領取優惠券；國際版的優惠券較少。

koreanair.name: Korean Air
koreanair.note: Korea's flag carrier (now merging with Asiana). Promo codes go in the booking page; SKYPASS members get member fares.
koreanair.note_zh: 大韓航空（正與韓亞航空合併）。在預訂頁輸入優惠碼；SKYPASS 會員有會員票價。

asiana.name: Asiana Airlines
asiana.note: Asiana runs country-specific fare sales and card offers. It is merging into Korean Air, so check where your miles go.
asiana.note_zh: 韓亞航空在各地推出機票優惠及信用卡優惠。正併入大韓航空，留意里數安排。

jejuair.name: Jeju Air
jejuair.note: Korea's largest budget airline, flying to Hong Kong, Japan and Taiwan. Big seat sales run a few times a year; bags cost extra.
jejuair.note_zh: 韓國最大廉航，航線包括香港、日本及台灣。每年有數次大型機位減價；行李另外收費。

lotterent.name: Lotte Rent-a-Car
lotterent.note: Korea's largest rental company, with English booking at Incheon and Jeju. Bring an International Driving Permit.
lotterent.note_zh: 韓國最大的租車公司，仁川及濟州可用英文預訂。記得攜帶國際駕駛執照。

coupang.name: Coupang
coupang.note: Korea's biggest online store with next-day Rocket delivery. Ships within Korea only, except Rocket Direct to Taiwan.
coupang.note_zh: 韓國最大的網上商店，有翌日 Rocket 送貨。只送韓國，Rocket Direct 可寄台灣。

oliveyoung.name: Olive Young
oliveyoung.note: Korea's top beauty store. The Global site ships to Hong Kong and has first-order codes; stores in Seoul give tax refunds on the spot.
oliveyoung.note_zh: 韓國最大的美容店。Global 網站可寄香港並有首單優惠碼；首爾門市可即場退稅。

gmarket.name: Gmarket
gmarket.note: Korean marketplace with a Global site that ships abroad. Coupons are claimed on the event page; watch overseas shipping costs.
gmarket.note_zh: 韓國網購平台，Global 網站可寄海外。優惠券在活動頁領取；留意海外運費。

musinsa.name: Musinsa
musinsa.note: Korea's top streetwear site with a Global store. New members get a welcome coupon; sales run around big shopping days.
musinsa.note_zh: 韓國最大的街頭服飾網站，設有 Global 店。新會員有迎新優惠券；大型購物節會減價。

yesstyle.name: YesStyle
yesstyle.note: Hong Kong-based shop for Korean and Japanese beauty and fashion, shipping worldwide. Reward codes and tiered spend discounts are common.
yesstyle.note_zh: 香港公司經營的韓日美容及時裝網店，全球送貨。常有獎賞碼及分級消費折扣。

kakaot.name: Kakao T
kakaot.note: Korea's main taxi app. Visitors can now sign up with a foreign phone number and pay with a foreign card.
kakaot.note_zh: 韓國主要的召的士 App。旅客現可用外國電話號碼登記並以外國信用卡付款。

baemin.name: Baemin
baemin.note: Korea's biggest food delivery app. Coupons are claimed in the app; you need a Korean phone number to order.
baemin.note_zh: 韓國最大的外賣 App。優惠券在 App 內領取；需韓國電話號碼才能落單。

creatrip.name: Creatrip
creatrip.note: Korea travel app for tickets, beauty bookings and currency exchange, made for visitors from Hong Kong, Taiwan and Japan.
creatrip.note_zh: 為香港、台灣及日本旅客而設的韓國旅遊 App，可訂門票、美容及兌換外幣。

evaair.name: EVA Air
evaair.note: Taiwan's EVA Air runs online fare sales and card offers on each country's site. Infinity MileageLands members get member fares.
evaair.note_zh: 長榮航空在各地網站推出網上機票優惠及信用卡優惠。無限萬哩遊會員有會員票價。

chinaairlines.name: China Airlines
chinaairlines.note: Taiwan's flag carrier. Promo codes come with bank card offers; Dynasty Flyer members get occasional member sales.
chinaairlines.note_zh: 中華航空。優惠碼多與銀行卡優惠一同推出；華夏會員不時有會員減價。

starlux.name: STARLUX
starlux.note: Taiwan's new premium airline, flying Hong Kong, Japan and beyond. Launch and seasonal sales are the main savings.
starlux.note_zh: 台灣新晉高端航空公司，航線包括香港、日本等。開航及季節性減價是主要省錢方法。

tigerair.name: Tigerair Taiwan
tigerair.note: Taiwan's budget airline flying to Japan, Korea and Hong Kong. Flash sales and Tigerair Club deals beat codes; bags cost extra.
tigerair.note_zh: 台灣廉航，航線包括日本、韓國及香港。閃購及 Tigerair Club 優惠通常比優惠碼更划算；行李另外收費。

momo.name: momo Shop
momo.note: One of Taiwan's biggest online stores. Coupons and card cashback are claimed on the event page; ships within Taiwan.
momo.note_zh: 台灣最大型網購平台之一。優惠券及信用卡回贈在活動頁領取；只送台灣。

pchome.name: PChome 24h
pchome.note: Taiwan online store with 24-hour delivery. Coupons appear on the event page and with card partners.
pchome.note_zh: 台灣網購平台，24 小時到貨。優惠券在活動頁及信用卡合作優惠中提供。

taiwantaxi.name: Taiwan Taxi 55688
taiwantaxi.note: Taiwan's biggest taxi fleet and app. Discounts come from payment partners rather than public codes.
taiwantaxi.note_zh: 台灣最大的的士車隊及 App。折扣多來自付款夥伴，而非公開優惠碼。

tixcraft.name: tixcraft
tixcraft.note: Taiwan's main concert ticketing site (also in Hong Kong and Singapore). No discount codes; card presales come first.
tixcraft.note_zh: 台灣主要的演唱會門票網站（香港及新加坡亦有）。沒有折扣碼，信用卡持有人可優先購票。

kktix.name: KKTIX
kktix.note: Taiwan ticketing for gigs, talks and festivals. Organisers sometimes give discount codes for early tickets.
kktix.note_zh: 台灣的演出、講座及音樂節票務平台。主辦單位有時會提供早鳥優惠碼。
